name: Smash with Obelisk's domain-sacrifice cost and reserve-cost POWER bonus
notes: Engine gap: the 'Play prereq' (requires a domain on field, activateCardPrereqs["2kkvoqk1l7:0"]) was wired via the schema/generator, but DoActivateCard's hand-written cost-declaration switch (GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php) never queued the pre-existing SmashWithObeliskSacrifice DQ handler, so playing the card skipped the mandatory domain sacrifice entirely and always resolved with +0 POWER. Fixed by wiring $hasSmashObeliskCost the same way as the other mandatory-sacrifice additional-cost cards (Undeniable Truth, Blazing Throw), and extending SmashWithObeliskSacrifice to queue the reserve payment + EffectStackOpportunity steps those cards' handlers also queue. NEOS element access is granted by patching the starting champion's Subcards; a plain rules-text-free DOMAIN (Wool Brook, reserve cost 4) is seeded onto the field to sacrifice. Player 1's turn is passed through first since CanActivateAttackCardNow/IsFirstTurnAttackLocked forbid the true first player from playing an ATTACK card on turn 1, so player 2 plays the card on their own first turn instead.

rulesClauses: As an additional cost to activate this card, sacrifice a domain you control.
Smash with Obelisk gets +X POWER where X is the reserve cost of the sacrificed domain.
